universal: Every harness on this bus shares an append-only ledger, replay, doctor, receipts, and typed refusals — those do not vary by surface.
orchestrator_note: Orchestrators (t3, herdr) run other harnesses inside themselves. Floati reads the orchestrator's own surface - its sessions and panes are the truth when agents run there. The harnesses underneath keep their own rows and their own receipts; supporting them is a different promise than supporting the orchestrator.
surface_scope_note: Surface rows are the reference machine's MEASURED installs (C0-DELTA photograph), not the product catalog. Two absences are deliberate, not oversights: Claude.app is desktop chat, not a Claude Code seat - classified out, the same cut that separates ChatGPT Classic from Codex; and no Codex IDE extension was installed at photograph time - that row lands when the MX-1 campaign photographs one, not before.
